meal.title: Install BeautifulSoup4, lxml, and requests
meal.objective: Install beautifulsoup4, lxml, and requests using pip

voice.script: Want to start scraping but missing the tools? Which packages do you need to install? We’ll import modules after installing them. Run these pip commands: pip install beautifulsoup4 pip install lxml pip install requests. Remember: beautifulsoup4, lxml, and requests are the core trio. Now try installing the packages on your own machine.
